target_customer: Engineering and security teams at companies running web applications and APIs
problem: Pattern based web firewalls miss attacks and are hard to tune. Teams wanted protection that sees what happens inside the running app.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription for an in-app security agent
product_category: Runtime application self-protection and application security management

founders.name: Pierre Betouin
founders.background_notes: Led security products at Datadog after the acquisition, per YC page.

founders.name: Jean-Baptiste Aviat
founders.background_notes: Named as co-founder in an Alven interview title only.

competitors.name: Contrast Security
competitors.what: Language agent based RASP and IAST

technical_complexity.rationale: In-app agents had to hook many languages and frameworks with low overhead and without breaking production apps.

defensibility.rationale: Deep integration into apps raises switching cost, but several RASP vendors existed and larger vendors could acquire.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Consolidation followed. Imperva bought Prevoty in 2018, Fastly bought Signal Sciences in 2020, and Datadog bought Sqreen in 2021.

market_need_then: Forrester ran a RASP New Wave evaluation in Q1 2018, which shows an emerging market with eight significant vendors.

branding.domain_note: Used sqreen.com, now dead (DNS does not resolve).

identity.logo: Not described in any source found

brand_strength.rationale: A niche developer security brand with a registered trademark and about 800 customers. No evidence of broader brand pull.

outcome_analysis: Sqreen sold an in-app security agent to developers, reached about 800 organizations and raised a 14 million Series A led by Greylock in 2019. Datadog acquired it in 2021 on terms not disclosed, and it became Datadog application security. The exit fits a consolidating RASP market where Prevoty and Signal Sciences were also bought.
notes: Company website fetch failed with a DNS error (site dead after acquisition). Seed round amount unknown: one aggregator lists 120K in 2018, unverified. Total raised stated as over 18M including Series A. Competitor names come from a Forrester 2018 report listing; no traction data available.
